dct_description_sm: The Principal Investigators would appreciate users of this dataset informing Dr. Aaron Berg (aberg@uoguelph.ca) or Qianyu Chang (qchang@uoguelph.ca) about their intended uses of these data and would also appreciate receiving copies of reports based on the dataset.

As the shrub cover expands across the Arctic tundra with climate warming, an accurate and cost-effective tool to quantitatively map the shrub cover is needed. This dataset and the associated study explore the potentials of L-band SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite image (ALOS-2) in estimating Arctic shrub biomass and leaf area index (LAI). This dataset includes in-situ measurements of shrub canopy parameters and the ALOS-2 derived maps of birch shrub biomass and LAI in Trail Valley Creek watershed, Northwest Territories.
dct_title_s: Shrub aboveground biomass and Leaf Area Index maps, Trail Valley Creek Watershed, Northwest Territories [Canada], 2018 to 2019
